text:
tyler: FYI starting a focused entitlement cleanup for analytics+ml service accounts next week. owners will get a ping — please verify admin roles or mark for demotion.

neha: quick Q: during the last sweep we accidentally demoted a support helper svc that had a temporary KMS grant tied to an open incident. can the demotion job honor a grant-level `incident_tag` so temporary elevations are skipped?

sam: we do have an `incident_id` in some grants but not all. the issue is grants created by SDK paths lack requestor/incident metadata. we need to enrich the grant records before pruning.

lee: created infra ticket #2834 to add two fields: `grant_origin` and `incident_tag`. plan: populate `grant_origin` from audit_events and set `incident_tag` when the grant originates from incident workflows. will also add `auto_revert` flag.

tyler: thanks. for the upcoming run i suggest we widen the grace window to 21 days and require both `auto_revert=false` and `incident_tag IS NULL` before demotion. that should avoid hitting recent incident work.

access-bot: Automation notice: scheduled prune job "admin-clean-svc-roles" set for 2026-04-07T03:00Z. Current grace_days=7. To request change, open PR: infra/tools/admin-prune#update-grace.

neha: 21 days seems conservative but safe. also request: include `grant_origin` in the review export so owners can triage console vs sdk vs support-lambda grants at a glance.

sam: agreed. i'll run a one-off backfill to tag SDK grants where audit events show a matching request_id. snippet:
```
UPDATE kms_grants g
SET grant_origin = 'sdk'
FROM audit_events e
WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id
  AND e.source = 'sdk'
  AND g.grant_origin IS NULL;
```

lee: i'll add the schema migration and webhook change to infra#2834. also will make the webhook idempotent so retries don't create duplicate grants.

tyler: can someone own producing a whitelist of incident-tagged grants for the automation to skip? we'll need that list by Tue EOD.

neha: i'll take the whitelist. will exclude any grant with `incident_tag IS NOT NULL OR created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '21 days'`.

sam: after the run let's produce a short report: total grants scanned, demoted count, whitelisted count, and any grants lacking requestor metadata. i'll draft the query.

access-bot: Action items logged: (1) infra#2834 add grant fields and idempotent webhook (lee), (2) whitelist by Tue EOD (neha), (3) backfill script for grant_origin (sam), (4) PR to change grace_days to 21 (tyler).

tyler: perfect. if anyone sees renewed grant churn during the window ping me and i'll pause the job. thanks all.
